prompt:
Production Unity enemy Swarmer sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity silhouette/proportions, redraw the same creature's articulated action frames in that view. Matte dark brown rocky armor, warm pale gray-white sinew, amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera, soft upper-left light. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
EVERY frame orientation: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing bottom-left, nose toward bottom-left, front legs nearest viewer. Keep the same angle in every pose. No turning body or changing camera angle in any row.
FOUR columns and 4 rows, EXACTLY 16 complete full creatures. SQUARE canvas width:height=4:4. Each sprite fits central 60% of equal cell, transparent 20% margins all sides. Full bodies MUST NOT touch/overlap other frames. Same body scale and ground anchor through all states. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Actual articulated joints and distinct foot placements; no duplicate still frames, no rotation-only or scaling-only simulation. Four consistent legs, one head, same plates. True transparent alpha0 empty pixels and holes. No background/shadows/floor, no text/labels/grid, no particles or projectile.
